title: Medical Receptionist: Patient Registration
subtitle: Hospital reception and intake in Japanese

sentences.en: Good morning. Do you have an appointment today, or are you a first-time patient?
sentences.target: おはようございます。本日はご予約でしょうか、それとも初診でいらっしゃいますか？

sentences.en: May I have your health insurance card and photo identification, please?
sentences.target: 健康保険証と写真付きの身分証明書をお持ちいただけますか？

sentences.en: Please fill out this registration form with your name, date of birth, and address.
sentences.target: こちらの問診票にお名前、生年月日、ご住所をご記入ください。

sentences.en: The doctor is currently seeing patients — your wait time will be approximately thirty minutes.
sentences.target: 現在、先生は診察中です。待ち時間は約30分になります。

sentences.en: Your copayment for today is 1,500 yen — will you be paying by cash or card?
sentences.target: 本日の自己負担額は1,500円です。現金とカード、どちらでお支払いになりますか？

sentences.en: I will send a reminder to your mobile phone the day before your next appointment.
sentences.target: 次回の予約前日に携帯電話へリマインダーをお送りします。

sentences.en: Please return this completed questionnaire to the reception desk before your appointment.
sentences.target: ご記入いただいた問診票を診察前に受付窓口へお戻しください。

sentences.en: Your test results will be ready in three business days — we will contact you when they arrive.
sentences.target: 検査結果は3営業日後に出ます。結果が出次第、ご連絡いたします。
